normalMotionQuranRegression.method: Actual production Expo WEB, unmodified live Quran responses and real wheel scrolling from a cold list. Normal animations are enabled by default, with a separate reduced-motion control. No content mocks; not installed Android/iOS device validation.

limitations: Google form navigation is intercepted only in browser tests to prove destination/new-tab/no-referrer behavior without a submission; no claim of third-party availability or form content review.

Native default-browser handoff/failure/duplicate-press paths use explicit unit bridge doubles and actual handler code. Hermes exports do not prove installed-device behavior. The OS controls the chosen external handler.
No new app permissions, data clearing/migration/deletion, third-party analytics, account flow, dependency or app-store submission. No Tajweed or Mufahras change.
